name: Engine oil capacity (with filter)
notes: 2.0 TFSI (EA888 Gen 3). Approximate — always verify on the dipstick/refill.
source: Audi Repair Manual · 2017–2018 Fluid Capacity Tables (A4 8W)

name: Engine oil specification
notes: CYMC 2.0 TFSI uses VW 502 00 (5W-40). The B-cycle DBPA engine uses VW 508 00 / 509 00 (0W-20) — check the oil placard / engine code.
source: Audi Repair Manual · 2017–2018 Fluid Capacity Tables (A4 8W)

name: Coolant capacity
notes: G13 (VW/Audi) coolant. Refer to the parts catalog for the exact spec.
source: Audi Repair Manual · 2017–2018 Fluid Capacity Tables (A4 8W)

name: Transmission fluid — 7-speed S tronic (DL382)
notes: 0CK/0CL/0CJ dual-clutch. Mechatronic/gearbox (MTF) initial fill 3.8 L; rear final drive 0.67–0.95 L.
source: Audi Repair Manual · 2017–2018 Fluid Capacity Tables (A4 8W)

name: Transmission fluid — 8-speed Tiptronic (0D5)
notes: quattro automatic. Front final drive 1.0 L initial / ~0.9 L refill; transfer case 1.0 L.
source: Audi Repair Manual · 2017–2018 Fluid Capacity Tables (A4 8W)

name: Manual gearbox oil — 6-speed (0CX)
source: Audi Repair Manual · 2017–2018 Fluid Capacity Tables (A4 8W)

name: Brake fluid capacity (system)
notes: Full system fill. Use a DOT 4 / VW-spec fluid; refer to the parts catalog.
source: Audi Repair Manual · 2017–2018 Fluid Capacity Tables (A4 8W)

name: Washer fluid reservoir
source: Audi Repair Manual · 2017–2018 Fluid Capacity Tables (A4 8W)

name: A/C refrigerant charge
notes: PAG compressor oil 110 cc. 2018-MY cars built during 2017 may use R1234yf — confirm the under-hood label before servicing.
source: Audi Repair Manual · 2017–2018 Fluid Capacity Tables (A4 8W)

name: Cold tyre pressure (normal load)
value: F 2.2 bar (32 psi) / R 2.0 bar (29 psi)
notes: Base A4 2.0 on 16–18" wheels. Some 18–19" fitments run F 2.3 bar (33 psi) / R 2.2 bar (32 psi). Always follow the driver's-door-jamb placard for your exact wheel/load.
source: Audi MY2016 Normal Load Condition Tire Pressure Table (A4 2.0)
